description: Update an existing webhook's endpoint URL, subscribed events, and/or active status. Only the provided fields change. Use `status: 'inactive'` to pause delivery without deleting. Returns the updated webhook.

endpoint.description: New HTTPS endpoint URL. Omit to keep the current one.

events.description: New full list of event names to subscribe to (replaces the previous list).

status.description: Set 'active' to enable delivery or 'inactive' to pause it.

webhook_id.description: ID of the webhook to update.

name: update_webhook
